answer: Jittered handshake windows. Each identity must complete its first N actions inside randomly assigned, non-overlapping timing windows; a missed window resets enrollment. A raven agent's activity pattern thus becomes a shape signal: sybils launched together cluster in time, while honest agents spread across the meadow of windows. Operators must sustain real-time traffic across many staggered windows, and each identity's vault of scheduled slots costs fresh monitoring hours, not one bulk registration.
